product.name: CloudCruise Browser Automation API
product.description: An API that converts complex browser workflows into stable, automated processes running in a Google Chrome environment, handling bot detection and session management.

product.name: CloudCruise Maintenance Agent
product.description: An automated system that monitors and repairs browser automation workflows by detecting and fixing broken selectors without manual intervention.

product.name: CloudCruise Workflow Builder
product.description: A tool that allows users to define browser automation workflows by describing processes, which are then compiled into adjustable automation graphs.

product.name: CloudCruise Secure Credential and Session Management
product.description: A service that securely manages user credentials, maintains cookies, and handles two-factor authentication to keep user sessions active during automation.

product.name: CloudCruise Data Upload and Download Service
